tone.target: clean tight funk rhythm with wah and compression
tone.profile: clean tight funk rhythm with wah and compression
tone.summary: A tight, percussive funk rhythm tone achieved with compression, a wah effect, and a clean American-style amplifier setup.

rig.name: Average White Band - Pick Up The Pieces - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up background noise and maintain tight transients.
Provide consistent volume and emphasize the percussive attack required for funk.
Simulate the essential wah pedal sweep for funk rhythm playing.
blocks.gap: The GP-180 does not have a dedicated Wah module. Green OD is used as the closest filter/sweeping effect available to achieve the tonal character and movement of a wah pedal.

blocks.purpose: Keep the tone clean and avoid distortion/crunch.
Provide a clean, bright American tone suitable for funk and rhythm playing.
Select a compact, bright cabinet sound that complements the clean US Deluxe amp.
Fine-tune the frequency response to enhance the punch and clarity of the rhythm guitar.
Add a subtle sense of space without muddying the tight funk rhythm.
blocks.gap: The target specified 'keep it dry' and avoid heavy reverb, but a minimal Room effect is used to simulate the small room clue while maintaining tightness.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for better punch and definition in funk rhythm.

proposals.recommendedAsset: Funk/Rhythm IR (e.g., Fender Twin or Ampeg SL-6)
proposals.reason: Enhance the percussive punch and definition required for funk rhythm.
